limitations: Entity names and grouping were derived from authored mesh names and are a reviewable semantic proposal, not ground-truth object recognition.
SAM text concepts produce candidate instances; identical concepts do not establish which instance matches a particular Blender entity.
Never reuse a multi-instance concept union as the individual mask of each repeated Blender item. Concept-level unions must use the corresponding Blender entity union.
Separate scene manifests constrain scene-conditional evaluation; compare shared concepts/entities separately from each scene's own inventory.
Objects with needs_review remain included in render IDs but should not become unreviewed instance-level accuracy claims.
The point-cloud reference and camera helpers are not rendered entities; these clean authored-scene exports contain no such mesh helpers.
